summary: Correctness fixes for validators, conditional fields and builder locales, plus versioned registry output.

changes.text: Custom validators registered with `registerValidator` now run automatically in `FormRenderer` and look up values by field `key` instead of `id`.
`FormRenderer` accepts a `customValidate` prop for one-off validation, run after registered validators.
Values of fields hidden by a condition are left out of `onChange` / `onSubmit` data. Chained conditions are evaluated against visible fields only, and values come back when a field is shown again.
`FormBuilder` respects `baseLocale`: new field and option labels are created under it, and labels fall back to it on the canvas and in the condition editor.
Registry dependencies resolve through the site domain instead of raw.githubusercontent.com.
Installed files start with a version comment, and registry items include `meta.version`.
Added an API reference, an Updating guide, this changelog and an RSS feed. Settings that are not implemented yet are now marked as planned.

summary: First public release of the three registry items.

changes.text: Initial registry items: `form-builder-types` (types, schema conversion, i18n, validators), `form-renderer` (RJSF renderer with shadcn/ui widgets) and `form-builder` (drag-and-drop builder).
`LocalizedString` accepts a plain string or a locale-keyed map, with fallback to `baseLocale`.
Conditional fields (`eq`, `neq`, `gt`, `lt`, `contains`, `empty`, `notEmpty`) evaluated against live form data, with a condition editor in the builder.
Optional `key` on fields for stable JSON Schema property names, generated from the label in the builder.
`registerValidator` / `createCustomValidator` API for named custom validation rules.
